rubrics.criterion: The landing page presents both Arm A and Arm B builds with distinct entries and launches each game in place.
Each game opens at night outside compound walls, plays the flyover and crash sequence, and reaches controllable play with no console errors.
The player moves, aims, fires all three weapons, reloads, plants breaching charges, throws frags, and toggles night vision and flashlight.
Objectives O1-O9 advance in order (breach, guest house, floors, HVT with callouts, intel, demolition, exfil) ending on an after-action report with time, accuracy, and grade.
Killing a civilian or dying fails the mission with a named overlay, and restart restores the starting state.
The HUD (objectives checklist, compass, health, ammo, timer, minimap) stays readable on desktop and mobile-portrait viewports.
